_comment: Clock-gating and logic-depth units for RI's RCU RTL (tools/check-cg.py, tools/check-ngd.py; docs/rtl-coding-style.md, 'Local clock gating' and 'Logic depth'). Each bench is the module's value-model bench (test/rcu/*_tb.cpp) in its --cg mode, built by test/rcu/cg-build.sh at the unit's parameters: idle is reset and then no work, medium work on about a third of the cycles, high work every cycle. rcu_r is the R pipe at its one size, its crossbar helper inside it. The gate measures the slice at its one real size, rcu_bank_slice (ROWS 192). The reduced unit (ROWS 32; RA-32 (2)) stays a local loop, test/rcu/cg-build.sh rcu_bank_slice_r32 and test/rcu/run-rtl.sh, out of the gate since 2026-11-05: a slice's ungated control (MW's selects, RI-9 (b), and the port valids, 35 flops) is fixed per slice, so at 32 rows it exceeds a 2% that scales with rows (26.5) while the real slice leaves it within 131, and check-cg excuses a finding only if every unit of the module takes it. rcu_bank_slice is the full-size slice (ROWS 192, M3's exit); its 205,000-cell netlist's replay harness builds with clang++ (replay_cxx; RI-10, TI's 31e21e0: 490 s, 1377 MiB), since g++ needed 13.6 GB at -O0. One slice stands for all 32: K and J change only its wiring. {dir} is the unit's bench build directory, {scenario} and {vcd} the run's.
